The '''Ab'Bshingh civil war''' was a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-long war between the [[Waroot]] and [[Farang]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Ab'Bshingh]].

==Behind the scenes==
When the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the many battles were studied by the Imperial strategist [[Crat Dakerno]], who was sent to subjugate the two races sometime between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Dakerno used their complex maneuvers to create the board game known as [[B'shingh]].
